source.reductions: Reduce the first Kustomization from each pinned actual/atuin ks.yaml. Preserve original declaration paths, application paths, metadata namespaces, targetNamespace and common metadata. Omit the storage Kustomizations, components, health checks and readiness edges. Replace each chart with an authored same-named ConfigMap; namespace-specific CLI invocations are authored selection witnesses, not a claim about upstream operational failures.
